modeHint.video: Forces this through yt-dlp instead - for a video a site's own extractor can't grab, or a page from a site Foldreel doesn't support at all.

dashboard.modeMismatch: This site has a dedicated extractor. Use Auto to get the posts. Whole page / Scan only grab page chrome (logos, icons) because posts load via JavaScript.

dashboard.rateLimited: The site is rate-limiting your IP. Waiting helps; retrying right away can extend the block. A VPN or proxy gives you a fresh IP.
dashboard.rateLimitedWait: Rate-limited by the site. Best to wait about {{min}} more min. You can still retry now, but it may extend the block.
dashboard.emptyTip: Paste a link above to start. Drop a .txt file of links onto the box to add many at once.
dashboard.siteBlocked: TikTok is blocking this request (HTTP 403). Turn on Browser mode for TikTok in Advanced, Engine, or try again later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.folderCustomDesc: Slash-separated gallery-dl fields, e.g. {category}/{user[name]}. Use the Insert field button.

tokens.title: Post title
tokens.type: Media type: Photos, Videos, GIFs, or Audio

settings.defaultLimitDesc: How many files to grab per download. A number means the newest N; or a range like 8-20 or 1:100:2. Blank = everything.
settings.maxConcurrentDesc: How many URLs download at once. Set 0 to pause the queue.
settings.rateLimitDesc: Max bandwidth, e.g. 1M or 500k. Blank = unlimited.
settings.proxyDesc: Route all requests through a proxy, e.g. http://host:port or socks5://host:port. Useful when a site rate-limits your IP. Blank = direct.
settings.sleepRequestDesc: Delay before each request. Helps avoid rate-limit bans.
settings.retriesDesc: Attempts per file before giving up.
settings.skipExistingDesc: Remember what you've downloaded so re-running a URL only grabs new files, even ones you later deleted. Turn off to re-check and re-grab everything.
settings.writeMetadataDesc: Save a .json sidecar with post info next to each file.
settings.cookiesFolderEmpty: No cookies.txt files yet. Export one from your browser:
settings.cookiesFolderNoDomains: No domains were found in these files.
settings.cookiesFolderInfo: Any cookies.txt files here are merged and applied to the matching site by domain.
settings.browserRunning: {{name}} is running. Chromium browsers lock their cookie database while open; quit {{name}} for Foldreel to read it.
settings.startWithWindowsDesc: Launch Foldreel on login, minimized to the tray.
settings.notificationsDesc: Show a desktop notification when a download finishes or fails.
settings.extensionDownloadDesc: Not yet on the Chrome Web Store. Download it and load it manually (chrome://extensions, Developer mode, Load unpacked).
settings.extensionDownloadStore: Get it on the Chrome Web Store
settings.extensionDownloadStoreDesc: Install it straight from the Chrome Web Store - it'll update itself from there too.
settings.extensionOpenFolderDesc: The extension ships with Foldreel itself - open its folder and load it unpacked (chrome://extensions, Developer mode, Load unpacked).
settings.extensionPrivacyDesc: What the extension does and does not do with your data.
settings.extensionEnableDesc: Send the current tab straight to Foldreel, no copy-paste. Generates a pairing code for the browser extension on this computer. It can queue downloads and, only when you click "Send cookies for this site", read that site's cookies - it never reads settings or saved site credentials.
settings.extensionCodeDesc: Paste this into the Foldreel extension's popup to connect it.
settings.extensionRegenerateDesc: Invalidates the current code and disconnects the extension until you pair it again.
settings.extensionDisableConfirmDesc: The extension will no longer be able to send downloads to Foldreel until you enable it again.
settings.toolUnsupported: No one-click installer for this OS. Install via your system package manager.
settings.configEditorDesc: Foldreel's own settings only cover part of what gallery-dl supports. Anything you add here (per-site filters, postprocessors, sites with no dedicated page here, ...) is layered on top of the generated config, so it survives the next time a Settings change regenerates it.
settings.presetsIntro: A preset is a gallery-dl config snippet, applied only to a download that picks it from the Dashboard - the same JSON as Settings > Files' config editor, just named and optional per job.
settings.presetsEmpty: No presets yet - add one below, or start from an example.
settings.dataFolderDesc: Database, config, logs, download archive, gallery-dl cache, and downloaded tools. Set the FOLDREEL_DATA env var to move it.
settings.defaultPhotoFormatDesc: Converts HEIC, WEBP, and other photo formats to your choice as they download - handy for iPhone exports.
settings.defaultVideoFormatDesc: Converts MOV and other video formats to your choice as they download.
settings.clearCacheDesc: Removes generated thumbnails and gallery-dl's internal cache. Nothing you downloaded is touched.
settings.autoStartElectronOnly: Auto-start only works in the packaged app
settings.aboutTagline: Download, convert, rename, and watch your media - all in one app.
settings.componentsDesc: The tools Foldreel downloads with. Checking and updating run in the background.
settings.privacyDesc: What Foldreel does and does not do with your data.
settings.privacyBody1: Foldreel runs entirely on your machine. It has no accounts, no analytics, no telemetry, and no server of its own. Your URLs, downloads, cookies, and settings never leave your computer through Foldreel.
settings.privacyBody2: When you start a download, Foldreel runs gallery-dl, which connects directly to the sites you gave it, plus any browser cookies or logins you configured on the Sites page. Those requests go to those sites, exactly as if you visited them yourself. If you set a proxy, traffic goes through it.
settings.privacyBody3: gallery-dl, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and aria2c ship inside the installer itself. Foldreel contacts GitHub only to check for newer versions (of itself at launch, and of these tools when you press Check for updates) and to download an update you choose. No information about you is sent. Everything Foldreel stores lives in the local data folder shown above and can be deleted at any time.
settings.licenseDesc: Foldreel is released under the MIT License.
settings.noticesTagline: Each component keeps its own license.
settings.noticesFootnote: gallery-dl and aria2c are licensed under GPL-2.0, FFmpeg under LGPL-2.1/GPL, and yt-dlp under the Unlicense - each bundled as a separate, unmodified executable that Foldreel invokes as a subprocess. Foldreel's own source is MIT.
settings.deleteModeDesc: What the Delete key does in the Library. Deleting permanently always asks first, like Windows.

sites.title: Sites
sites.uploadHint: Upload a cookies.txt for this site, or leave it to the browser selected in Cookies & Auth above.
sites.cookieActive: A cookies.txt covering {{domain}} is in use.
sites.cookieFallback: No cookies.txt for this site. Foldreel will use the selected browser.
sites.cookieUploadFailed: That file is not a valid cookies.txt.
sites.waitingBrowser: Waiting for you to authorize in the browser…
sites.howItWorks: Instagram needs cookies for everything. Twitter needs them for NSFW / protected / rate-limited. Pixiv needs a refresh-token. The rest are optional but raise limits.

welcome.title: Welcome to Foldreel
welcome.body: Download, browse, edit, convert and organize your media in one app. Here is a quick tour.

dashboard.title: Downloads
dashboard.body: Paste one link or many, one per line. Links to a file or a video stream work too. The folder and file names are the chips under the box.

watch.title: Watch
watch.body: Turn a link into a recurring check that saves only what is new, into the folder you pick for it.

convert.title: Convert
convert.body: Drop any photo or video to change its format or size. HEIC and MOV become JPG and MP4.

organize.title: Organize
organize.body: Pick files or folders, drag them into order, and rename them all at once.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: The download folder and file names, theme, language and updates.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.body: Download speed and limits, the browser extension link, and presets.

sites.title: Sites: private accounts
sites.body: Instagram, Twitter, Pixiv and similar need a login. Pick a browser for Foldreel to read cookies from, or upload a cookies.txt for that site. Reddit, DeviantArt and others use one-click OAuth.

history.title: History
history.body: Every finished download is listed here. Open a row for its pictures, log, re-download or delete.

library.title: Library
library.body: Your download folder as a file manager: folders, five views, search, drag and drop, favorites, tags and a duplicates finder. Videos play right here. Press and hold, or drag a box, to select many.

edit.title: Edit
edit.body: Trim on a timeline, crop, turn, add text and looks, change speed and sound, then save a copy.

import.title: Import from Grabbr
import.rowDesc: Bring across your settings, history, watches, logins and download record. Nothing in Grabbr is changed or deleted.
import.none: No Grabbr data found in the usual place. If you moved it, choose its folder yourself.
import.scanFailed: Could not look for Grabbr data
import.badFolder: That folder has no Grabbr data
import.failed: The import failed. Nothing was changed.
import.running: {{app}} is still running. Close it first, so both apps do not check the same watches.

catDesc.settings: Folder layout, filenames, limits, language and theme.
catDesc.presets: Your saved presets and the gallery-dl overrides.
catDesc.history: Finished downloads only. Anything still queued is left behind.
catDesc.watches: Profiles and searches you were checking. Ones you already watch here are kept.
catDesc.sites: Usernames, passwords and tokens. Sites already set up here are kept.
catDesc.cookies: Saved browser logins. The newer copy of a file wins.
catDesc.archive: Remembers what was already downloaded, so nothing is fetched twice.
catDesc.tokens: gallery-dl sign-in tokens, for sites like Reddit and Flickr.

import.folderUnset: The old install had no download folder set.
import.safe: A backup of your current data is saved first. {{app}} stays untouched.
import.folderConnected: Your old download folder is now the download folder.
import.backup: Your previous Foldreel data was backed up before importing.

extension.linkedDesc: Last used {{time}} ago. Send pages, images and videos to Foldreel from your browser.
extension.foundDesc: It last checked in {{time}} ago. Press Link and Foldreel will connect it for you.
extension.notFoundDesc: Install the extension in Chrome or Edge, then open it once. Foldreel notices it by itself.
extension.step1: Click the Foldreel icon in your browser toolbar (or open its settings page).
extension.step2: That is all: it connects within a couple of seconds. This stays open for 10 minutes.
extension.unlinkDesc: Stops the extension from sending to Foldreel until you link it again.
extension.manualDesc: Make a pairing code and paste it into the extension's settings page.
extension.sameComputer: The extension works with the browser on this computer only. Foldreel listens on this computer and nowhere else, so a pairing code cannot be used from another device.

engine.parallelDesc: How many links download at the same time. More is faster, but busy sites may slow you down.
engine.pausedNote: The queue is paused, so nothing will download. Pick a number to start again.
engine.speedLimitDesc: Keeps Foldreel from using all of your bandwidth.
engine.delayDesc: A short pause between requests helps avoid being blocked by busy sites.
engine.retriesDesc: How many more times to try a file before giving up.
engine.limitDesc: Stop after the newest few files. Choose Custom to type a range such as 8-20.
engine.saveInfoDesc: Keeps a small .json file with each file's post details (caption, date, author) next to it.
engine.proxyDesc: Send downloads through a proxy server. Leave empty to connect directly.
engine.resetDesc: Puts every setting on this page back the way it came.
engine.tiktokDesc: Turn on if TikTok downloads fail with HTTP 403.
